June 24, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Louis Bacon increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 20.57% Moore Capital Management Lp bought 233,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.58% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Louis Bacon held 1.37M shares of the business services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $251.17M, up from 1.14M Moore Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $519.06B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.10% or $0.2 $202.01. About 9.62M shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 61.13% 48.56% the S&P500.
